# Quill & Page cover CDN edge log (2026-09-22)

Fields: timestamp, request, path, edge node, cache result, origin status, latency.
The Hangzhou node qcd-hz2 was renamed to qcd-hz-b on 2026-09-20; the config
switch completed around 09:20 that day. Both names are the same machine.

turns.prompt: Quill & Page's cover CDN logged origin fetch failures yesterday (2026-09-22). In logs/cdn-edge.log, which edge node logged the most cache=ERR rows?
Count only the failures at or after 12:00:00 — which node is top then?
What's the timestamp of qcd-bj1's first fetch failure after noon?
